ask: can u make a poll for dumpling house, siam corner, el patron and joe's
sentence: A single-choice poll where each person votes for one restaurant from a fixed list, can change or withdraw their vote, and sees live counts and who voted.
use_when: a group needs to pick one place to eat from a short list
people want to see vote counts and who chose what
voters may change their mind before a deadline
a quick decision among a few set options
dont_use_when: people need to pick more than one option or rank choices
the options must be added or edited after the poll starts
you need a split of a bill or an order list rather than a vote
